rubric_items.reason: CO-1, CO-5 and CO-6 now have tests, and REQ-10 is traced and tested. Two story paths are still untested: S-5 AC3 (the only appointment today is Cancelled, so the list is empty and the count is 0) and S-2 AC3 (clearing a doctor-only filter).
Tests assert exact ids in start order, totals, today_count equality, exact request URLs and the select value. The no-bare-id check now matches the exact id text.
Covered: the 400 for an unknown status, Cancelled starting last, the 00:30 Kolkata edge, the evening-before row and an Inactive doctor opened from a link. Missing: the zero-count edge (S-5 AC3).
Vitest with Supertest on a fresh PostgreSQL behind skipIf(pgAvailable), and Vitest with Testing Library and MemoryRouter. Names start with HMS-8 REQ-n. The duplicated loop is now in expectKept.
No test or coverage numbers are stated. The artifact defers to the verifier, and checks.json shows tests passing and coverage skipped (exit 78).

findings.text: S-5 AC3 is untested. No test sets up a doctor whose only appointment today is Cancelled and checks that the NOT_CANCELLED list is empty while today_count is 0.

cites.quote: Given a doctor's only appointment today is Cancelled, when staff select that doctor's Today link, then the list shows no appointments, matching a Today count of zero.
today's NOT_CANCELLED list equals the doctors list's Today count, including 00:30 local

findings.suggested_fix: In the NOT_CANCELLED suite, insert one Cancelled row today for doctor 2. Assert that today_count is 0 and the NOT_CANCELLED list for today has total 0.

findings.text: S-2 AC3 is untested. The only Change test starts with the patient, status and dates set (KEPT). No test clears a doctor-only filter and checks that the list request then has no filters.

cites.quote: Given the list is filtered to doctor A only, when staff clear the doctor filter from the chooser, then the list shows appointments of every doctor.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a test that renders '/appointments?doctorId=1', clicks Change and expects the last list call to be '/api/appointments'.

cites.quote: API tests use Vitest and Supertest against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with a fixed clock
Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID
Without either, database tests are skipped.
The verifier skips coverage (the project has no coverage script)
Kolkata is UTC+05:30 all year, so local HH:MM on a day maps to a fixed UTC instant.
